title: Unifying Detection and Adaptation in Task-Free Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.27070v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To mitigate catastrophic forgetting in downstream continual learning (CL) for large language models (LLMs), existing methods typically constrain parameter updates or introduce task-specific adaptation modules. However, these methods often rely on explicit task boundaries during training, limiting their applicability to realistic task-free scenarios. In this paper, we propose a \textbf{Fi}sher-guided \textbf{uni}fied (\textbf{FiUni}) framework for batch-level task detection and parameter-efficient continual adaptation. FiUni is motivated by a key observation about the Fisher information matrix (FIM) of pre-trained models: the orthogonality among the principal subspaces of its Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) approximation, estimated from a small number of downstream task samples, can reflect the similarity between different tasks. translated_title: 统一任务检测与自适应于无任务边界的持续学习
translated_abstract: 为了缓解大型语言模型（LLMs）在下游持续学习（CL）中的灾难性遗忘问题，现有方法通常限制参数更新或引入特定任务的适应模块。然而，这些方法在训练过程中往往依赖显式的任务边界，限制了它们在现实无任务场景中的适用性。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为**Fi**sher引导的**uni**fied（**FiUni**）框架，用于批量级任务检测和参数高效的持续适应。FiUni的动机来自对预训练模型Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）的一个关键观察：其Kronecker-Factored近似曲率（K-FAC）近似的主子空间之间的正交性，通过少量下游任务样本估计，可以反映不同任务之间的相似性。基于这一观察，FiUni构建了由FIM派生的冻结子空间来引导低秩适应。
tldr: 本文提出FiUni框架，利用Fisher信息矩阵的K-FAC近似主子空间正交性，实现无任务边界下的批量级任务检测和参数高效持续适应，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the FiUni framework, which leverages the orthogonality of principal subspaces in the K-FAC approximation of the Fisher information matrix to enable batch-level task detection and parameter-efficient continual adaptation without task boundaries, mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
